name: Go 9x9
description: Go on a 9x9 board with area scoring and komi, played natively by the board mechanism.

brief.situation: A game of Go on a 9x9 board. Black (X) plays first against White (O).
brief.rules: Take turns placing a stone on an empty point (written like c3) or pass. A group of stones with no empty point next to it is captured and removed. You may not place a stone where your own group would have no liberties unless it captures, and you may not immediately retake a single stone in a ko. Two passes in a row end the game. Area scoring: your stones plus the empty points only you surround; White adds 7.5 komi.

roles.player: You play {$actor.name}. Control more of the board than your opponent.
